text:
rajesh: seeing sustained GPU pool saturation in us-east-1 for the last 30m, tail latencies spiking and queue depth climbing. one tenant is using most of the shared pool. grafana: https://grafana.redwood.prod/d/cluster/fleet-us-east1 (query: gpu_queued_requests)
mina: yep noticed it too. looks like burst tokens tanked and admission backpressure not aggressive enough. can we apply a temporary per-tenant cap and tighten burst window? :warning:
alyssa: +1. prefer graceful shielding over hard evictions. reduce burst from 200 -> 50 and set soft preempt threshold at 85% GPU util. would buy us headroom while we triage.
rajesh: can someone patch the admit-controller config? quick patch only, we can revert after incident.
sam: I can push a hotfix. proposed config snippet:
```
admission:
  global_capacity_pct: 0.85
  per_tenant:
    default_rps: 20
    burst_tokens: 50
    weight_shares: true
  soft_preempt:
    enabled: true
    threshold: 0.85
    grace_window_s: 30
```
sam: applying now to us-east-1 shared pool (hotfix, no restart, dynamic reload) :gear:
deploy-bot: rolled out admit-controller v1.8.3-hotfix -> us-east-1/shared-pool (config patch) by sam
mina: after patch qlen dropped ~40% and tail p95 latency down from 1.2s -> 420ms. still seeing one tenant at ~60% of capacity though.
alyssa: for that tenant can we throttle their concurrency and enable prefix caching? if they're doing lots of short completions caching will help a lot.
mike: FYI this will increase per-token cost for cached requests temporarily. log cost delta and tag billing so we can send a note to finance if needed.
rajesh: short-term plan recorded: 1) short throttle + reduced burst (done) 2) enable prefix/KV caching for noisy tenant (ops runbook) 3) schedule medium-term: implement dynamic weighted token-buckets (per-tenant share based on plan + recent usage) 4) long-term: offer reserved capacity for heavy tenants
mina: follow-ups: add telemetry metrics: tenant_share, preempt_count, dynamic_burst, per_tenant_qlen. also add alert when one tenant > 50% for >10m.
sam: opening a follow-up PR for dynamic-weighting and a canary rollout to us-west first.
rajesh: thanks all. leaving this thread open until we confirm steady state. moving incident doc to #incidents with links and actions. :thumbsup:
